current.text: Milwaukee's guard rotation is crowded. Rollins, Herro, Porter, Burries, Trent, Green and Jakučionis all compete for backcourt minutes.
His role is not clear. He will probably be in the rotation, but Gary Trent Jr. could take that spot instead.
Experts call Milwaukee the rotation they understand least and have low confidence in how minutes will be split.
New coach Taylor Jenkins might use a deep rotation, which would spread guard minutes further.
He was seen as the deal breaker in the Giannis trade.
Milwaukee could use him as a trade chip, valued like a first-round pick. The roster has too many players and needs trades to consolidate.
He posted good assist and steal numbers in summer league.

durable.text: He is better in category leagues than in points leagues.

ESPN projects about 8 points, 3.3 assists and 1.5 threes in 22.6 minutes. No category stands out and none is weak enough to make him a punt fit. Early in the season, check whether he holds a rotation spot over Gary Trent Jr. in the crowded Bucks backcourt, and watch for trade news. If his minutes grow, he is a waiver add for assists, FT% and a low turnover rate.
